prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. A compact eight-pose painted game animation sheet, genuine transparent alpha. The reference is this project's own Noxian base Legion soldier, identity and material reference only. Preserve open-faced worn iron cap, red cloth tunic, simple leather, narrow round buckler, broad single-edged sword, face/helmet, Noxian buckler crest, colors, right sword hand and left shield hand in every pose. Same grounded original Heroes III painted-prerendered material language, warm upper-left light, rich matte textures, no outline. All eight full-body figures separated with generous margins, no clipping. Exact arrangement FOUR columns and TWO rows.
TOP ROW: four subtle equipment-check fidget keyframes for a planted idle soldier looking RIGHT. 1 start guard sword near right hip and shield beside left side; 2 small wrist adjustment lifting blade a little; 3 finish wrist adjustment; 4 return guard. Keep both boots planted in IDENTICAL locations, identical lower-body drawing, same knees/hips/root height across these four: no stepping, knee flex, leaning, sideways drift, shield swapping or attack. A tiny arm/neck gesture only.
BOTTOM ROW: four HALF-TURN keyframes. 1 calm RIGHT-facing three-quarter guard; 2 rotate slightly toward camera; 3 near-frontal; 4 fully FRONT-facing guard, chest toward viewer. Character rotates in place with plausible pivoting feet. NEVER show his back. Keep sword in physical right hand and shield in physical left hand, correct left/right as he faces camera. This row must progress right→front, NOT turn back to right, NOT full180turn. All have the SAME body scale and ground baseline; compact relaxed pose, no lunge or attack. Empty transparent gutters; no text or gridlines or floor. Full blades and feet visible. These are separate true articulated poses, not static repeats.
